good_thing: (New Zealand): The Department of Conservation’s Kākāpō Recovery programme says the kākāpō population has exceeded 300. For one of the world’s rarest parrots, that is a lovely number to see growing.
current_or_history: On September 7, 1911, poet Guillaume Apollinaire was arrested during the investigation into the Mona Lisa’s theft. Suspicion was linked to stolen Louvre statuettes connected to someone he knew, and he spent a week in La Santé prison.
tiny_fact: An octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood through its gills, while the third sends oxygenated blood around the rest of its body.
thought: Small recoveries count, even when they arrive one careful number at a time.
